schema.description: Request schema for creating a provider

add_user.description: Whether to grant the provider access to the dashboard.

initial_schedule.description: The provider's initial schedule, created atomically with the provider when a brand-new provider row is created (ignored on reactivation or affiliation of an existing provider). All fields are optional. Omit the object or pass `null` for no schedules; an empty object `{}` still creates a schedule with `effective_from` defaulted to yesterday and no weekly rules.

effective_from.description: The effective date of the schedule. Defaults to yesterday when omitted.

effective_to.description: The effective end date of the schedule.

public_bookings.description: Public booking settings for the schedule.

enabled.description: Whether public bookings are enabled for the schedule.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the weekly rules are authored in. Defaults to the provider's location time zone when omitted.

weekly_rules.description: Weekly rules for the schedule. Defaults to none when omitted.

items.description: Weekly rule for a provider schedule.

end_time.description: The end time of the rule.

start_time.description: The start time of the rule.

items.title: WeeklyRule

initial_schedule.title: InitialProviderSchedule

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs to attach to this provider. Maximum size is 16 KB.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the user (if `add_user` is true). If they don't already have an account, they will receive an email with instructions to set their password when this property is true.

role_ids.description: List of role IDs to assign to the user (if `add_user` is true).

time_zone.description: The provider's preferred IANA time zone, used as the default when authoring schedules. Defaults to the account location's time zone when omitted.

schema.title: CreateProviderRequest
